I'm an M.S. student in economics at Texas A&M University, graduating in May 2027.
My research interests are behavioral and experimental economics, industrial
organization and market design.

My current work asks whether prices in Kalshi's daily-temperature markets add to
public weather forecasts, and replicates Luco and Marshall's study of vertical
integration in the U.S. soft-drink industry. More on the
[Research & Projects](research.qmd) page.

I'm looking for predoctoral research positions starting in summer 2027.
